voluntaryConsent.title: Voluntary Consent
voluntaryConsent.shortDescription: Your job is something between an autopsy and a survey. In this detective visual novel, you are an interrogation inspector who extracts information from still-living brains. Every day you analyze documents, gather evidence, and make a hard choice: conscience, duty, or the voices in your own head.
voluntaryConsent.lead: “An easy little office job somewhere between an autopsy and a survey, friendly coworkers, quiet clients, and funny gadgets. Even a company flat, and not quite on the outskirts. Looks like I've landed on my feet. Now, what should I get for dinner?” — such were the thoughts of our hero, Konstantin Safin, inspector at the Republican Neural Safekeeping Service (RNSS). He had no idea what a sharp turn his snug little life was about to take over the next couple of days.

aboutSegments.text: is a detective visual novel set in a fictional world full of black humor, synthetic sounds, and 1-bit graphics. In this game we:

features: read documents (with our eyes) and minds (with the equipment);
talk to coworkers, witnesses, and other semi-inanimate objects;
wander the city at different times of day;
try not to die (or at least not in the dumbest way possible);
casually make hard choice between our conscience, the code of conduct, and the voices in our heads;
eat again (dinner) and go to bed on time.

meta.description: Strange House is an interactive fiction story where every decision changes the path ahead.
meta.ogImageAlt: Strange House — promotional art for the game

strangeHouse.title: STRANGE HOUSE

dialogue.visitorLine: What kind of game is Strange House?
dialogue.studioLine: Curious? Then settle in, and I'll tell you the story.

images.interiorAlt: Strange House atmospheric scene inside the house
images.roadAlt: Strange House atmospheric scene on the road

paragraphs: “These are troubled lands. I wouldn’t go wandering here for no reason.” Igor checked the front-door lock once more, then returned to the table. “After dark, I try not to step outside without a rifle. Truth be told, even with one I’d rather stay put till sunrise. So what brings you here? It’s a long night. Talk, and I’ll listen.”

Strange House is interactive fiction: a story that moves only by your choices. Will your path be long or cut short? Will you find common ground with those you meet—or make enemies? Happy ending, bitter one, or tragedy? It’s all on you, one decision at a time.
The game is available for Android smartphones (version 6 and above).
